mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% over a 6-month window signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 and remains above for 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5% for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 5% over a 6-month window signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 5.0 and remains above for 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 5% for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market strength, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above its 12-month moving average and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS > 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average over three consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO crosses below its 12-month moving average and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average over three consecutive months signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction sector earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST crosses above its 12-month moving average and remains above for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST > 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% over a 6-month window combined with a decline in payroll employment below its 12-month moving average signals a dual labor market weakening, which reduces earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 and remains above for 6 months AND PAYEMS crosses below its 12-month moving average and remains below for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 5% for 6 months AND PAYEMS < 12-month MA for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
